items.title: What Does Bristol Myers Squibb (BMY) Face After ZENBEXUS Approval And Patent Action?
items.summary: Bristol Myers Squibb (NYSE:BMY) received FDA approval for ZENBEXUS (iberdomide) in combination therapy for adult patients with relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma, based on minimal residual disease negative complete response. ZENBEXUS is the first FDA approved CELMoD therapy in this multiple myeloma setting, which may support broader clinical use.
